component.name: adifedit
component.summary: View and edit ham radio ADIF logs

description.p: adifedit opens an ADIF log (.adi / .adif), shows every record as a row and every field as a column, lets you edit it like a spreadsheet, and writes it back as plain ADIF.

It handles the jobs a logger makes awkward: fixing a wrong band on forty QSOs, adding fields such as MY_RIG or MY_ANTENNA to every record, dropping junk columns an importer created, or just seeing what is actually in the file.

ul.li: Edit any cell in place; insert, delete and fill rows and columns
Find and Find and Replace across cell values
Batch Stamp: write the same set of fields into every record from a reusable template
Opens files with mismatched field lengths on a best-effort basis, highlights what it repaired, and won't save over the original
Asks before saving over a log that another program, such as a logger, has changed since it was opened

description.p: It is deliberately not a logger: no database, no account, no network.

screenshot.caption: A loaded log as an editable grid

description.p: Adds a Windows installer with a Start menu entry and .adi/.adif file association.
Adds a Debian package for Ubuntu and Debian.
